# trackler

**Tag**: web, data

## 简介

All of the data necessary to construct exercises in any of the Exercism tracks. This includes the shared metadata.

## 官网

- 主页: http://exercism.io
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/trackler/2.2.1.180
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/trackler
